dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The upper-lateral region exhibits a series of well-defined 'O' shaped annuli. The edges show a sharp contrast transition from a dark exterior pixel boundary to a higher-luminance interior core. Notable structures include three aligned oval rings near the dorsal ridge and a large, fragmented 'C' shape in the mid-lateral section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed primarily near the anterior region (left) and interspersed between the larger macro-annuli. These clusters lack internal luminance gradients and appear as irregular, high-contrast points against the darker base coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a nearly linear horizontal chain. Connecting these to the largest lateral annulus creates an obtuse scalene triangle. A smaller cluster of four annuli in the mid-region forms a tight, irregular quadrilateral.
